components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it
            must be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and address (they share a household).
            Write-only; not stored and never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: A business identifier formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global
                4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## Summary

The spec: when a create-owner request sets `sharesHousehold=true`, allow an owner at an address already used by a same-lastName owner, assign both the same stable `householdId`, and return it.

The duplicate-household rejection and the `sharesHousehold` opt-out already existed (`CheckOwnerHouseholdUnique`). What was missing was assigning and returning the shared `householdId`. Changes:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added `householdId` (readOnly) to the `Owner` response schema. This flows through the OpenAPI-generated `OwnerDto` and the MapStruct `OwnerMapper` automatically (mapped by name, like `customerCode`), so it appears in both the POST create response and `GET /api/owners/{id}`.

2. **`Owner.java`** — added the `householdId` field (`@Column(name = "household_id")`) with getter/setter.

3. **DB schemas** — added `household_id` column to the `owners` table in all four `schema.sql` files (h2, hsqldb, mysql, postgres), and appended the corresponding `NULL` to the positional seed inserts in `hsqldb/data.sql` (the only seed file that would break the `ddl-auto=none` startup; h2/postgres use explicit column lists, mysql was already positionally short of its own schema and is unused by tests).

4. **`AssignHousehold.java`** (new function) — runs after `BuildOwner`/`AssignCustomerCode`, before `SaveOwner`. When `sharesHousehold=true` and an existing owner shares the normalized last name + address, it derives a **stable** id (first 12 upper-case hex chars of SHA-256 over the normalized `lastName|address`), sets it on the new owner, and back-fills it onto the existing housemate(s) so both carry the same value. Deterministic derivation guarantees every housemate computes the same id regardless of creation order.

5. **`owners.POST.yml`** — inserted the `assignHousehold` step (under `transaction` governance) into the pipeline.

All 21 tests pass, including the new `Cp10Tests` (household-duplicate) and `Cp11Tests` (shares-household) checkpoints.
